title: Toward Robust Medical Fairness: Debiased Dual-Modal Alignment via Text-Guided Attribute-Disentangled Prompt Learning for Vision–Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness and debiasing in medical imaging models, specifically addressing demographic biases related to race, sex, and skin type. While fairness is an ethical concept, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral philosophy.
